pages.text: Endgels are massive, eight-winged monsters that soar across the void of the outer end. With columns of eyes facing every direction, none are safe from its gaze. Once it spots a target, the Endgel relentlessly blasts them with explosive homing projectiles, in addition to charging up an even mightier attack.$(br2)If once is powerful enough to slay an Endgel, it will drop its heart, which can craft a $(l:hedges_bestiary:items/weapons)special weapon.
